title: A job through the shop
blurb: Print arrives, job runs, job ships. Where the time actually goes.
asks: A print lands on your desk. Walk me through to the day it ships.
sample:
From: Karen Ipswich <kipswich@ipswichcutting.example>

Attaching the print for job WO-2214. Qty 40 pcs, material is on our PO 7719. Need first article by 10/3 and the balance by 10/17. Ship to 3300 Appling Road. Give me a call at 901-555-0104 when you've had a look.

Thanks,
Karen

steps.name: Read the print and work out what it takes
Turn the accepted quote into a traveller
Type the traveller in and invoice
